points: 1 Open release: weights, the full Dolma training data, training/evaluation/adaptation code, 500+ intermediate checkpoints at 1000-step intervals and W&B logs, under Apache 2.0 (p. 1-2, 8)

2 Architecture: decoder-only transformer with no biases, non-parametric layer norm, SwiGLU (about 8/3 d, 11,008 for 7B), RoPE, and a modified GPT-NeoX BPE tokenizer with PII tokens (vocab 50,280, embedding 50,304) (p. 2)

3 Sizes and optimizer (Table 1, p. 1): 1B has L16, D2048, H16, 2T tokens, peak LR 4.0E-4, weight tying; 7B has L32, D printed as 4086, H32, 2.46T tokens, peak LR 3.0E-4, no tying; AdamW with betas 0.9/0.95, eps 1.0E-5

4 Training recipe: FSDP/ZeRO with bfloat16 mixed precision, global batch of about 4M tokens (2048 x 2048), 5000-step warmup, linear decay to a tenth of peak LR, gradient clipping at 1.0; run on LUMI (AMD MI250X, up to 256 nodes) and MosaicML (27 nodes of 8x A100) with nearly identical results (p. 4-5)

5 Final-checkpoint trick: the evaluated 7B checkpoint (2.46T tokens) is tuned 1000 more steps with LR linearly decayed to 0, which boosts perplexity and task scores; the evidence is Figure 1 only (p. 5)

6 Data: Dolma has 2,668B tokens, 4,367M docs and 11,519 GB, of which Common Crawl is 2,180B tokens; training used a 2T-token sample in a fixed, reconstructible order, with some runs starting a second epoch; curation details are deferred to the Dolma report (p. 3, 5)

7 Downstream zero-shot results on 8 tasks (Table 3, p. 5): OLMo-7B averages 69.3, against Llama 2 7B 70.5, Falcon-7B 70.3, MPT-7B 69.8, LLaMA 7B 69.6, RPJ-INCITE-7B 66.6 and Pythia 6.9B 63.0; OLMo-1B averages 60.4, against TinyLlama 59.4, Pythia 1B 54.5 and StableLM 1.6B 66.5; competitive, not best

8 Paloma perplexity: bits per byte on 11 of 18 sources, with OLMo's training data decontaminated against Paloma; results appear only in Figure 2; OLMo leads on C4 (88.8% Common Crawl) and is less sample-efficient on WikiText-103, M2D2 S2ORC and M2D2 Wikipedia; MPT-7B improves ahead on the combined plot (p. 4, 6)

9 Adaptation with Tülu SFT then DPO (Table 4, p. 7): OLMo base scores MMLU 28.3, ToxiGen 81.4, TruthfulQA 31.6; OLMo+SFT scores 47.3 / 57.0 / 14.4 / 41.2; OLMo+SFT+DPO scores 46.2 / 69.3 / 1.7 / 52.0; it still trails Tülu 2+DPO (50.7 / 85.1 / 0.5) and Llama-2-Chat (46.8 / 87.3 / 0.0)

10 Withheld and limitations: ablations are mentioned but not shown; no failed or diverged-run logs (p. 9); no compute cost or weight-decay value; the intro's four 7B variants do not match the artifact list (7B, 7B-twin-2T, 1B); English only; evaluations are noisy; a post-release update lifts MMLU by 24 points to 52% without describing the changes (p. 9)
